name: Shimoyuki Shihon
source:
Soraoka Yuuhi’s partner.

Although she has a self-centered personality, she’s so good at being cute that she’s practically unstoppable, allowing her to get things done exactly as she wants.

She’s obsessively attached to Soraoka Yuuhi and is always eager to be lovey-dovey with her.

[spoiler]She is murdered by an unknown assailant, her neck is severed, and her head is hidden somewhere.[/spoiler]
